core_obligations: Reduce U to affine via a scheme cover U' -> U; induction on the degree bound d.
Base case d = 1: U = X and Y = U.
Normalization factorization U -> Y -> X with pi integral and j quasi-compact open immersion, U scheme-theoretically dense in Y.
Decompose U x_X Y = U amal W; the degree of W -> Y is below d by the stratification lemma.
Apply the induction hypothesis to W -> V; extend Z -> Z' integral with Z scheme-theoretically dense.
Assemble Z' amal T -> X; verify surjectivity, integrality, and local factorization through U pointwise.
proof_roadmap: Reduction to affine cover; induction setup; normalization decomposition; degree drop; inductive step; assembly and verification.
difficulty_reason: An induction-on-degree construction with a normalization decomposition and a pointwise verification of three properties of the assembled cover.
